raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Summary

With `SGLANG_USE_AITER` unset (the default), `RMSNorm` and `GemmaRMSNorm` on ROCm run `forward_hip` on `vllm._custom_ops`. Both call `fused_add_rms_norm` with six arguments, `(out, input, residual_out, residual, weight, eps)`. vLLM and ROCm/vllm both define it as `fused_add_rms_norm(input, residual, weight, epsilon)` and update `input` and `residual` in place. So every layer with a residual fails:

```
TypeError: fused_add_rms_norm() takes 4 positional arguments but 6 were given
```

The six-argument call came in with #13814 (`RMSNorm`) and #21188 (`GemmaRMSNorm`). The argument order doesn't match aiter's `rmsnorm2d_fwd_with_add` either (its `residual_in` comes before `residual_out`), and `forward_hip` only runs when aiter is off.

This PR calls the vLLM op on copies of `x` and `residual`, so `forward_hip` stays out-of-place, and fixes the comment that documented the wrong signature.

## End-to-end (MI325X, TP1, `SGLANG_USE_AITER=0`, `Qwen/Qwen3-8B`)

| | main | this PR |
|---|---|---|
| startup | `TypeError` above during CUDA-graph capture | serves |
| GSM8K (`lm_eval`, 200 questions) | n/a | **0.95 / 0.95** (strict / flexible) |

## Test plan

- [x] End-to-end run above.

Found by [Hyperloom](https://github.com/AMD-AGI/Hyperloom); reviewed and measured by hand.
Hyperloom was optimizing `MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3-MXFP8` on MI325X; the crash showed up in `GemmaRMSNorm` while bisecting MiniMax-M3 with aiter off.

files.patch:
@@ -771,12 +771,13 @@ def forward_hip(
             # NOTE: Remove this if aiter kernel supports discontinuous input
             x = x.contiguous()
         if residual is not None:
-            out = torch.empty_like(x)
-            residual_out = torch.empty_like(x)
             if post_residual_addition is not None:
                 residual = residual + post_residual_addition
+            # in place: out <- norm(x + residual), residual_out <- x + residual
+            out = x.clone()
+            residual_out = residual.clone(memory_format=torch.contiguous_format)
             fused_add_rms_norm(
-                out, x, residual_out, residual, self.weight.data, self.variance_epsilon
+                out, residual_out, self.weight.data, self.variance_epsilon
             )
             return out, residual_out
         out = torch.empty_like(x)
@@ -1179,18 +1180,16 @@ def forward_hip(
             return self.forward_native(x, residual, post_residual_addition)
         else:
             w = self.gemma_weight
-            # vllm API: rms_norm(out, input, weight, eps) -> None (in-place)
-            #           fused_add_rms_norm(out, input, residual_out, residual, weight, eps)
+            # vllm API: rms_norm(out, input, weight, eps) -> None
+            #           fused_add_rms_norm(input, residual, weight, eps), in place
             if not x.is_contiguous():
                 x = x.contiguous()
             if residual is not None:
-                out = torch.empty_like(x)
-                residual_out = torch.empty_like(x)
                 if post_residual_addition is not None:
                     residual = residual + post_residual_addition
-                fused_add_rms_norm(
-                    out, x, residual_out, residual, w, self.variance_epsilon
-                )
+                out = x.clone()
+                residual_out = residual.clone(memory_format=torch.contiguous_format)
+                fused_add_rms_norm(out, residual_out, w, self.variance_epsilon)
                 return out, residual_out
             out = torch.empty_like(x)
             rms_norm(out, x, w, self.variance_epsilon)
